hypotheses.question: DEX trade information content
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: A signed DEX trade contains short-horizon directional information.

hypotheses.question: Trade size and response
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Larger USD trades have stronger signed future response.

hypotheses.question: Flow imbalance
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Buy/sell imbalance predicts subsequent clock-time return.

hypotheses.question: Flow continuation versus reversal
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: The response curve distinguishes transient pressure from persistent information.

hypotheses.question: Smart Money label validation
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: The external Smart Money label has incremental information content versus controls.

hypotheses.question: Whale Holder label validation
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: The external Whale Holder label differs from unlabelled trades.

hypotheses.question: Bundler label validation
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Bundler-labelled trades have a distinct response profile.

hypotheses.question: High-activity wallets
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Repeated wallets have different information content from one-off wallets.

hypotheses.question: Wallet persistence
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Past wallet response predicts later response under chronological split.

hypotheses.question: Participant concentration and crowding
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Higher buyer concentration is associated with reversal/crowding.

hypotheses.question: Cross-token robustness
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Trade-response effects are not driven by one or two tokens.

fixed_variants.inference: horizon-specific episode clusters plus cluster bootstrap CI; BH within research family

confirmation_rule: future append-only data is confirmation; historical data remains discovery
